senses.gloss: to contract; to press, squeeze in, force into close confinement.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 76b:15">Snh. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>לרבות את המְצַמְצֵם</he> this includes him who caused the death of a person by forcing him into a place whence he could not escape.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 77a:2">Ib. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>בנזקין … מצמצם</he> in cases of damages the Law does not condemn him who causes damage through confinement (e.g. by placing an animal where it was exposed to sunstroke). Pesik. Baḥod., p. 152ᵃ <he>מצמצם שכינתו ביניהם</he> forces his Divine Presence into their midst; ib. Vayhi, p. 5ᵃ.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>צִימְצְמָן בין וכ׳</he> he crowded them (the priests) between the two bars of the Ark (cmp. <cite ref="R00558"><he>צָמַד</he></cite>); a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְצוּמְצָם</he>; f. <he>מְצוּמְצֶמֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְצוּמְצָמִין</he>; <he>מְצוּמְצָמוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Ib.</cite> s. 11 (in Chald. dict.) <he>אנא חמיתיה מצ׳ ביניהון</he> I saw it (the Divine Presence) confined in the midst of them (the elders); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 964">Yalk. Prov. 964</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>ושאר איבריו מצ׳ בו וכ׳</he> and the rest of its (the embryo’s) limbs are pressed together like a shapeless lump; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:3:5">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>מצומתים</he>), v. <cite ref="C00398"><he>גּוֹלֶם</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to press against, hide behind. Pesik. Sos, p. 147ᵇ (ref. to Is. LXI, 10 ככלה) כיון … היו מְצַמְצְמִין עצמן וכ׳ when the Israelites stood at Mount Sinai they pressed themselves (against one another, in reverence) like a bride (when she undresses), opening one (part of her garment) and holding together another part.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:10">Cant. R. to IV, 10</cite> the Ten Commandments <he>שהיו מצמצמים עליהן ככלה</he> (sub. <he>עצמן</he>) at receiving which they hid themselves like a bride.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> end <he>והיתה … וצִימְצְמָה פניה וכ׳</he> she leaned on her maid and pressed her face (against her), so that the king could not see her &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 80">Yalk. ib. 80</cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:5:1">Cant. R. to VI, 5</cite> <he>הלכה וצמצמה פניה אחורי העמוד</he> she went and pressed her face (hid herself) behind a column; a. e.

senses.gloss: [to press the eye] to observe closely; to define exactly.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 2:6">Bekh. II, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 17a:21">17ᵃ</cite>) <he>אי אפשר לצַמְצֵם</he> (Mish. ed. <he>אי אפשר</he> only) it is impossible to ascertain exactly (that both heads came forth simultaneously). Ib. 17ᵇ <he>אפשר לצַ׳ בידי שמים</he> it is possible to ascertain simultaneity in natural processes; <he>א״א לצַ׳ בידי אדם</he> it is impossible to ascertain simultaneity in human actions.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 4:4">ib. IV, 4</cite>) <he>הא אי איפשר לצַ׳</he> but is it not impossible to ascertain simultaneity (of evidence of two witnesses)? <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 4:4">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 28b:16">Ḥull. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>חלקו … לפי שא״א לצ׳</he> if he divided the stove into two equal parts, both are unclean, because it is impossible to make an exactly even division; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1:15">Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ</cite> <he>שתהא החמה מְצַמְצֶמֶת בו באחד וכ׳</he> that the sun should shine on it exactly in the first moment of the solstice of Tebeth and of that of Tammuz.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:3:18">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חמשׁת … מצ׳</he> exactly five quarts.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:3:5">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>שלש על שלש מצ׳</he> exactly three by three (handbreadths).
Gitt. 7ᵃ אם … שמזונותיו מצ׳ if a man sees that his means of support are getting scanty; a. fr.—4) to stint, save, v. צָמַת.
